Home.heroTitle: Astrology as a tool for clarity, in service of your decisions.
Home.heroSubtitle: Every day, a short reading and one concrete action to move forward. Horosphère turns your astral data into decisions you can act on.

Cgv.title: Terms and conditions of sale
Cgv.intro: These terms govern the sale of credit packs and subscriptions on Horosphère. By making a purchase, you accept them without reservation.
Cgv.s1Title: 1. Purpose and nature of the service
Cgv.s1Text: Horosphère offers astrological readings generated on demand (horoscopes, birth charts, compatibility analyses, themed guidance, etc.), as digital content delivered immediately after payment is confirmed. This content is offered for entertainment and personal development purposes; it does not replace professional advice.
Cgv.s2Text1: Each pack corresponds to a fixed number of credits, debited as readings are generated, according to the cost shown for each type of reading on the Pricing page.
Cgv.s2Text2: Credits purchased as a pack are valid for {days} days from the date of purchase. After this period, unused credits are lost, with no refund.
Cgv.s2Text3: Payment is made in full at the time of purchase, via our payment provider Stripe.
Cgv.s3Text1: Subscriptions are billed monthly, by automatic renewal, via Stripe. Each cycle refills the number of credits associated with the chosen plan; unused subscription credits at the end of a cycle are not carried over to the next cycle.
Cgv.s3Text2: Some readings are reserved for active subscribers, regardless of their credit balance; they become inaccessible again if the subscription is no longer active.
Cgv.s3Text3: You can cancel your subscription at any time. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the already-paid period: access to subscription benefits (current cycle's credits, subscriber-only readings) remains active until that date, with no further renewal or billing.
Cgv.s4Text1: In accordance with Article L221-28 of the French Consumer Code, the right of withdrawal cannot be exercised for digital content supplied on an intangible medium whose performance has begun after the consumer's prior express agreement and express waiver of their right of withdrawal.
Cgv.s4Text2: By confirming the purchase of a credit pack or subscription, and by generating a reading that is made available immediately, you acknowledge that you are requesting immediate performance of the service and expressly waive your 14-day right of withdrawal for the content thus consumed.
Cgv.s5Text1: Given the immediate and digital nature of the service, credits already consumed (readings already generated) are not refundable.
Cgv.s5Text2: In the event of a proven technical fault preventing a reading from being generated after credits have been debited (for example, a server error), the affected credits are automatically re-credited or, failing that, upon simple request to support.
Cgv.s5Text3: For any billing anomaly (double charge, incorrect amount), a refund may be requested within 14 days of the transaction; it will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.
Cgv.s6Text: Payments are processed by Stripe. Horosphère does not store any bank details: payment information is entered directly on Stripe's secure interface.

PolitiqueConfidentialite.title: Privacy policy
PolitiqueConfidentialite.intro: This page describes what data Horosphère collects, why, for how long, who it is shared with, and how to exercise your rights — in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s1Text: The publisher of the Horosphère website (see the <legal>legal notice</legal>) is responsible for processing your personal data. Given the nature and volume of the data processed, appointing a Data Protection Officer (DPO) is not mandatory; any question relating to your data can be sent to <email>contact@horosphere.fr</email>.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s2AccountText: Email address (required), name (optional), password if you choose to set one — never stored in plain text, only in hashed form (see section 6). Necessary to create your account and let you log in.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s2ProfileText: First name, last name, date of birth, time of birth (optional), place of birth, phone number (optional). Necessary to calculate your sign, your birth chart and generate your personalized readings — the very purpose of the service.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s2HistoryText: The content of generated readings, the date and the number of credits spent, so you can find them again in your space.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s2PaymentText: Handled entirely by our payment provider Stripe: we never receive or store your bank details. We only keep your Stripe customer ID and subscription status, to sync your credits and feature access.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s2NewsletterText: Pre-checked box when creating your profile (can be disabled at any time from your profile, or in one click from each email received). Used only to send you the sky news published on Horosphère, at most once a week.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s2CookieText: A single cookie, strictly necessary to keep you logged in — no audience-measurement, advertising or third-party tracking cookie is set on Horosphère. Since this cookie is essential to the service's operation, its use does not require a consent banner (per CNIL guidance).
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s3Text1: Your account, birth profile, history and payment are processed for the performance of the contract that binds you to Horosphère from the moment your account is created (Article 6.1.b of the GDPR): without this information, the service cannot function.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s3Text2: The newsletter relies on your status as an existing customer for similar content to our service (the so-called "soft opt-in" exception); you can object to it at any time without affecting your access to the rest of the service.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s4Title: 4. Who your data is shared with
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s4Text1: Your data is neither sold nor rented. It is shared only with the technical providers necessary for Horosphère to operate, each acting as a data processor within the meaning of the GDPR:
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s4Vercel: Vercel (site hosting and code execution) — United States.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s4Neon: Neon (database, hosted on AWS) — hosting region: us-east-1 (Virginia, United States).
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s4Resend: Resend (sending the login link and newsletter) — United States.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s4Anthropic: Anthropic (AI-generated readings — your date of birth and first name are sent at the time of generation, never stored by this provider beyond processing the request) — United States.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s4Text2: Some of these providers may process data outside the European Union. In that case, they rely on the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or an equivalent transfer mechanism.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s5Text1: Your account, profile and history data are kept for as long as your account is active. Purchased credit packs expire after {days} days (see the <cgv>Terms</cgv>), without this leading to the deletion of your account.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s5Text2: Billing-related documents are kept for 10 years, in accordance with the legal obligation to retain accounting records.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s5Text3: If you request the deletion of your account, your data is erased within a maximum of one month (the legal deadline for responding to GDPR requests), subject to the legal retention obligations mentioned above.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s6Https: Encrypted connection (HTTPS) across the entire site.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s6Bcrypt: Hashed passwords (bcrypt) — never stored or viewable in plain text, including by the Horosphère team.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s6Cookie: Session cookie marked httpOnly, inaccessible to code running in your browser.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s6Bank: No bank data ever passes through or is stored by Horosphère — this step is fully delegated to Stripe.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s6Access: Database access restricted to Horosphère's own services, via a private connection not exposed publicly.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s7Text1: In accordance with Articles 15 to 21 of the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to and port your data. You can update your profile and newsletter preferences directly from <space>your space</space>, or exercise any of these rights — including the complete deletion of your account — by writing to <email>contact@horosphere.fr</email>.
PolitiqueConfidentialite.s7Text2: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL — <link>cnil.fr/fr/agir</link> — if you believe your data is not being processed in compliance with the regulations.
